chapters.title: The Papa Arrive, a Long Quiet and the Teachers
chapters.text:
Days 37 to 39 were crowded. A small band of the Papa came into the land from beyond its edge: Teka, Quipan, Zika and Yachi. Zika and Yachi courted, and on day 39 two children were born to them, Paque and Kiwa. Honi went past the edge of the known world and found new land in the North Ice, and Uveeth found more in the Dunmar Plains. Ways came quickly. Cowa and Elyys discovered farming, Tugek and Uveeth rafts, and Tugek boats. Olum, Skaruk and Ilyae discovered archery, Nande wells, Xaiel smelting and Ssassa sailing. Elyis built a longhall and Shoka a store. Tonka raided a store of Balar's people. A storm broke on day 39.

From day 40 to day 57 the record holds only a few things a day. A blight withered half the redcap on day 41, the earth shook on day 42, and a sickness came on the wind on day 47. Stores were raided by Tonka, Zichi and Nauwa, and Nande found one robbed of six food. Huahua starved on day 47 and Xaiel on day 57. Many grew old in these days: Ilyae, Elyis, Honi, Hoka, Tugek, Elyys, Kragog, Balar, Keri and Vorok.

Day 58 was busy again. Ilyae died of old age, and the fenfowl died out. Wawa was born to Shoka and Shoma. Mepan, Nauque, Elyys and Hawen awakened to arts. Zurar discovered wells, Zihua mining, Hawen pottery and Vesys signs. The settlement Ssassa's Roof was no more, and Ssassa's Hold formed.

Days 59 to 61 belonged to the teachers. Kika discovered schooling, called Fireside Teaching, and taught it to Tlapan and Kiwa. Vesys discovered schooling too, and taught Zurar and Eiuine smelting. Elyis died of old age on day 59 at Vaia Heights with Elyys at hand; Elyys took over the wall, the hall and the two stores he left, and Elyys's Hold formed. Zika was gored by a mammoth on day 60. Three children were born that day: Thakar to Olum and Huatli, and Nando and Kende to Hawen and Tontec. Shoma discovered rafts and Kiwa invented the glasspick. A storm broke on day 61.

Alive rose from 39 to 46 and deaths from 9 to 14. For all the rafts and boats discovered, the record shows no crossing of water.
chapters.why: Written again on 23 November 2026 from the full record of days 37 to 60. The first writing was shown only the last 140 entries of the span, all from days 59 and 60.
